capabilities: insert LaTeX symbols from a categorized palette
convert a screen-selected region to LaTeX via OCR
convert clipboard images to LaTeX via OCR
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX renderer or typesetting engine; it only generates and inserts formula source code into notes.
extras: OCR requires configuring an external API endpoint, key, and model name in settings; no default hotkeys are set, so users must bind the six commands themselves; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Typing LaTeX formulas in Obsidian requires memorizing syntax, and converting formulas from images or the screen means using separate OCR tools and pasting results manually.

relations.evidence: a visual editor powered by MathLive and a quick-insert symbol palette

requires.name: OCR service (API endpoint, key, model name)

summary: Formula input panel that generates LaTeX from a clickable symbol palette with live preview, and converts screenshots or clipboard images to LaTeX via OCR.
